summary: Excellent comprehensive test suite across three complementary layers. Unit tests (test_artifact_cleanup.py) thoroughly exercise core logic including all three retention policies, error handling, CLI, and config loading with hand-computed fixtures and helper functions (_art, _by_name, _combined_plan). Structure tests (test_workflow_structure.py) validate YAML correctness, trigger presence, job dependencies, matrix coverage, and actionlint compliance. Integration tests (test_workflow_act.py) run the complete workflow through `act` Docker container, verify exact metrics per fixture case (keep_n, age, size, combined, empty), validate job success counts, and capture detailed act-result.txt output for debugging. Tests are well-organized by TDD cycles with clear comments, use proper pytest patterns (fixtures, capsys, raises), achieve independence through isolation, and follow red/green methodology documented in code. Edge cases thoroughly covered: boundary age conditions, empty lists, combined policies accumulating reasons, deleter failures. Test would catch regressions effectively across pure logic, error paths, and CI/CD integration.
